judgementCalls: 'In good standing with the Massachusetts Board of Pharmacy' (under Certifications) plus the Staff Pharmacist title is keyed as one required pharmacist licence; the issuer is not checked.
'In good standing' may be read as active or as no stated status, so the licence's status is not checked.
'Nine years of retail experience' is accepted as the total or as a role-family figure.
Russian is never listed as a language, only 'Translated pharmacy communications for Russian speaking customers'; a Russian entry is allowed but not required, and English is not allowed.
The clinical rotations are part of the PharmD, not separate education entries; the earlier 'Pharmacy technician' job title is not a credential.
